column1: # REVIEWED rows for the h3ccmped image.
# ownership=whole-section requires complete native byte/relocation verification; - makes no claim about unnamed interior entries.
# Whole-section claims were checked against full pinned COFF sections and every relocation; folded source-owned copies remain aliases.

column8: evidence
stricmp.obj's __stricmp under its OLDNAMES spelling: the Libraries' LODFile::Find (0x449e40) calls strcmpi, which LINK binds to this body
fopen.obj and wfopen.obj assemble to the same 19 bytes and differ only in the opener they call; LODFile::open (0x44a080) calls _fopen here
fread.obj and fwrite.obj assemble to the same 47 bytes; this one calls __fread_lk (0x451b7e), and LODFile::open and read (0x44a080, 0x44a270) call _fread here
